shell.runner.accountAutoHint: Your saved account; one already at its limit is skipped when you start a task
shell.stop.title: Stop {name}?
shell.stop.subNoReport: Its lead gets no report from it: it stops waiting for this one.
shell.stop.queuedOne: Your queued follow-up stays, held until you send one.
shell.stop.queuedMany: Your queued follow-ups stay, held until you send one.
shell.stop.plain: The run ends where it is.
shell.switcher.title: Switch task
shell.fallback.task.missing: This task isn’t here any more
shell.overlap.moreTitle: All the tasks that change the same files
shell.cold.line: Cache gone cold: this reply re-reads about {about}
shell.cold.tip: The prompt cache for this task has lapsed, so a reply reads the whole conversation back in. That costs far more than a reply while it’s warm.
shell.cold.compactNote: About {now} now, {cold} once the cache is cold
shell.cold.compactTip: Shrinks this conversation to a summary, so the next reply reads that instead.
shell.cold.compactPlan: Estimates at API list prices. On a plan you pay no dollars: it counts against your usage window.
shell.cap.label: Capped at {mode}
shell.cap.title: A channel started this task, so it runs at {mode} or lower. Picking a higher mode lifts the cap.
shell.cap.liftTitle: Lift the cap and switch this task to Full auto
shell.projects.machineTitle: Run agents on another computer over SSH
shell.projects.none: No projects yet. Add a folder above, or pick one below.
shell.projects.name: Project name
shell.projects.hint: Paste a GitHub URL and wisp clones it for you. Or run wisp add inside any folder: it is added automatically.
shell.reply.queueOn: Queueing: follow-ups wait until {name} finishes. Click to send now instead.
shell.reply.queueOff: Sending now: follow-ups interrupt {name}. Click to queue them instead.
shell.rerun.hint: Starts a new task in {cwd} on {where}. “{title}” is kept as it is.
shell.feedback.ideaHint: What works, what’s missing, what you wish it did…
shell.feedback.bugHint: What happened, and what did you expect? The steps to get there help most.
shell.feedback.how: How is wisp working for you?
shell.feedback.oneBug: One bug per report, so each one gets fixed.
shell.feedback.note: Goes to the wisp team with your wisp version and OS. Not your code or prompts. Tip: type /feedback … or /bug … in any prompt box.
shell.feedback.saved: Saved: it goes out once wisp is back online.
shell.rate.up: Good result: tell the wisp team
shell.rate.down: Bad result: tell the wisp team
shell.rate.why: What went wrong? Optional, goes to the wisp team
shell.rate.whyNote: Sent with the harness and model, not your prompt or code.
shell.rate.thanks: Thanks! Sent to the wisp team.
shell.reveal.failed: Couldn’t open the folder. The file is at {path}.
shell.btw.waiting: {name} is answering on the side · the run carries on
shell.usage.compactedTip: Compacted: the next turn says how full the context is
shell.usage.contextTip: {n} tokens in the context, as its last turn left it. Compact shrinks it
shell.usage.contextTipOf: {n} tokens in the context of the model’s {window}, as its last turn left it. Compact shrinks it
shell.usage.contextLineTip: {tip}. Click for all of its usage
shell.usage.planTip: This task’s share of its plan, its subagents’ included, as wisp traced it from what the CLI reports. Click for all of its usage
shell.usage.label: Task usage
shell.usage.inTurnsTip: Ran inside the task’s turns: their tokens are in the task’s
shell.usage.tokensTipSubs: {n} tokens read and written, {subs} of them by its subagents
shell.usage.planSplit: {own} by the task, {subs} by its subagents
shell.usage.subApart: Open “{title}”. Its share is of another plan’s windows, so the task’s line leaves it out
shell.runner.notInstalledTip: Install {name} on this computer and sign in, then open this again: wisp looks for it each time.
shell.runner.goalHint.balanced: Frontier models · default or medium thinking
shell.runner.goalHint.cheap: Lowest cost that still gets it done · low thinking
shell.runner.goalHint.best: Frontier models · high thinking; cost only breaks ties
shell.runner.autoNote: wisp picks the harness and model for each task from what worked before, and learns from how it went.
shell.runner.goalRefused: Auto’s goal didn’t change: this wisp refused it
